title: Direct a scene
blurb: Black bars go up, the camera moves around the room, and the player gets walked to the computer.
how: the_tour is a plain function with the scene in it, line by line, top to bottom.
look_at("trophies", ms=1500) moves the camera to a spot over 1500 milliseconds, which is a second and a half. look_at(None) gives the camera back to the player.
walk_to("the_desk") takes the controls and walks the player to that spot.
yield from as_a_cutscene(the_tour()) plays the whole thing with the black bars up, and takes the bars down at the end, even if something in the middle breaks.
try: Change the order: look at the computer first, then the trophies.
Add a stop. After the walk, add one more say at the computer.
Slow the camera down to 3000 and decide which speed feels better.
breaks: The last line needs yield from, not just yield, and the_tour() needs its brackets.
look_at(None) is missing. That's what hands the camera back.
The name in look_at or walk_to isn't on this map.
clip: say:A scene is a function. It runs top to bottom.
say:walk_to walks the player for them.
say:as_a_cutscene puts the bars up and takes them down.
